review: Tight nearly frontal monitor insert retains same grey-haired slate-jacket newsreader and cyan split-screen graphics. Enlarged right aerial panel clearly shows blue-tank depot, seated white-robed broker, rust-clad Harper offering small blue glint, plum-clad Taffy reaching at broker side. Camera elevated, partners' facial features remain indistinct. Scene identity clearer without mugshots/text. Warm casing/pipes preserve relay location.
caveats: Broker face silhouette is readable more than partners; Harper/Taffy faces remain small and non-identifying.
High aerial geometry includes several tanks; exact depot geometry is interpretive, consistent visual landmarks retained.
Tiny action hand details cannot be anatomically counted at surveillance scale.
No timing or shotlist changes by worker.
